brief: Reject an unverifiable guaranteed-high-return claim using independent verification steps.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Verify Claims"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Verifica la promesa de rendimiento"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Confira a promessa de rendimento"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Reject an unverifiable guaranteed-high-return claim using independent verification steps.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A promise can look official while leaving no independent way to verify who pays or why.
instruction.misconception: A badge, referral or screenshot makes an implausible guaranteed-return promise trustworthy.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: An offer promises unusually high guaranteed returns. Pause payment and verify the provider and claim through independent official information.
A seller-controlled link cannot independently verify the seller.
A copied logo does not establish authorization or performance.
One payment does not validate the scheme’s future obligations.
An unresolved identity mismatch is not cured by urgency.
A real firm’s existence does not validate an unsupported promise.
Independent contact avoids relying entirely on the sender’s controlled channels.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
